data.desc: XCF Global, Inc. ('XCF') is a U.S.-based renewable energy company focused on fueling the future by accelerating the production and deployment of cleaner fuels utilizing agricultural and other waste products. Following its recent combinations with Southern Energy Renewables and DevvStream, XCF is building a vertically integrated platform across the clean fuel sector, employing today's commercially scalable technologies, future lower cost-reduced carbon technologies and environmental asset management and monetization. The Company's flagship facility, New Rise Renewables Reno, produces renewable diesel, sustainable aviation fuel and renewable Naptha, and has a permitted nameplate production capacity of up to 40 million gallons per year.
